title: Three groups of three
caption: Group means 5, 7 and 9 give a between-group sum of squares 24 on 2 df and a within-group sum of squares 6 on 6 df, so F = 12/1 = 12 > 5.14: the means differ.
alt: Three box plots for groups A (4, 5, 6), B (6, 7, 8) and C (8, 9, 10), each of width 2, centred at 5, 7 and 9, touching at the ends.
description: Each group has spread 2 (SS = 2 each, 6 in total within).
The group centres 5, 7, 9 are 2 apart, so the between-group SS is 3 × (4 + 0 + 4) = 24.
